technique_name: Describe how Natural Language Processing (NLP) works.
description: Natural Language Processing (NLP) is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to understand, interpret, and manipulate human language. NLP functions with a range of algorithms and is built on the foundation of deep learning. The primary steps in an NLP workflow consist of language understanding, language generation, and dialog management.
